column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 26 (E99017): Peri, Qiuhua, dan Sabrina mengantar "pesanan" ke
# garis pertahanan Pradaja yang baru; Peri kembali jadi Underground Broker logistik.
# Tetap Inggris: Sabrina, Peri, Qiuhua, Pradaja, Paradajz, Commander, Oathguard, Vasily,
# Underground Brokers, Mokosh, Mangi Security, Yellow Zone, White Zone, Florence, Nemesis,
# Doll, guobaorou.
(—Beepbeepbeep.)
column2: (—Tittittit.)

column1: (The never-ending notification sound rang out once again, startling Sabrina, who was already somewhat overwhelmed, and nearly causing her to drop the pizza in her hands.)
column2: (Bunyi notifikasi yang tak ada habisnya itu kembali berbunyi, mengagetkan Sabrina yang sudah agak kewalahan, dan nyaris membuatnya menjatuhkan pizza di tangannya.)

column1: Be careful.
column2: Hati-hati.

column1: (Peri reached out a hand to steady the pizza, helping Sabrina regain her balance. Then she turned around and used her other hand to answer the comms.)
column2: (Peri mengulurkan tangan menahan pizza itu, membantu Sabrina kembali seimbang. Lalu dia berbalik dan memakai tangannya yang lain untuk menjawab komunikasi.)

column1: Hello, this is the—Pradaja Express Delivery Hotline! How can I help you?
column2: Halo, di sini—Hotline Pengantaran Kilat Pradaja! Ada yang bisa kami bantu?

column1: (The other party's words made Peri's expression a bit more solemn.)
column2: (Kata-kata pihak seberang membuat ekspresi Peri jadi lebih serius.)

column1: ...Yes, I understand.
column2: ...Ya, aku paham.

column1: Peri, these ten portions are done too, and we didn't put any green onions in them. As for the ones after that—
column2: Peri, sepuluh porsi ini juga sudah jadi, dan tidak kami beri daun bawang. Soal yang berikutnya—

column1: Whoa, what's with that expression, what's wrong?
column2: Wah, kenapa wajahmu begitu, ada apa?

column1: (Qiuhua, who is stir-frying over high heat nearby, sees Peri's expression and swallows half of her words back.)
column2: (Qiuhua yang sedang menumis dengan api besar di dekat situ melihat ekspresi Peri dan menelan kembali separuh kalimatnya.)

column1: (But Peri just gently places a finger to her lips, signaling Qiuhua to be quiet, and then continues talking to the person on the other end of the communication.)
column2: (Tapi Peri hanya menempelkan jari ke bibirnya dengan lembut, memberi isyarat agar Qiuhua diam, lalu melanjutkan bicara dengan orang di ujung komunikasi.)

column1: ...Mngh.
column2: ...Mng.

column1: ...Is that so?
column2: ...Begitu ya?

column1: 我明白了……
column2: Aku mengerti...

column1: (Peri nodded thoughtfully as she listened.)
column2: (Peri mengangguk sembari menyimak dengan saksama.)

column1: Did... did something happen?
column2: Apa... apa terjadi sesuatu?

column1: (At this time, Sabrina, who had put the pizza on the transport vehicle, also returns. She naturally gathers next to Peri along with Qiuhua. And at this moment, Peri also puts down the communication device in her hand.)
column2: (Saat itu Sabrina yang sudah menaruh pizza di kendaraan pengangkut juga kembali. Dia dengan sendirinya berkumpul di sebelah Peri bersama Qiuhua. Dan saat itu Peri juga menurunkan perangkat komunikasi di tangannya.)

column1: It's starting...
column2: Sudah dimulai...

column1: What?
column2: Apa?

column1: Let's set off, us.
column2: Ayo berangkat, kita.

column1: Why suddenly...
column2: Kenapa tiba-tiba...

column1: (Peri, however, takes two steps at a time and jumps onto the vehicle they originally used to transport food.)
column2: (Namun Peri melangkah dua-dua dan melompat ke kendaraan yang semula mereka pakai mengangkut makanan.)

column1: No time to explain, right now, we are going to save the Pradaja defense line!
column2: Tidak ada waktu menjelaskan, sekarang kita akan menyelamatkan garis pertahanan Pradaja!

column1: But didn't the Commander say that place was originally—
column2: Tapi bukannya Commander bilang tempat itu awalnya—

column1: (Although they hadn't fully reacted yet, Sabrina and Qiuhua cooperatively jumped into the car, even holding the boxed meals they had already prepared.)
column2: (Meski belum sepenuhnya paham, Sabrina dan Qiuhua tetap menurut dan melompat ke mobil, bahkan sambil memegang kotak makanan yang sudah mereka siapkan.)

column1: So... what you meant by saving the Paradajz defense line is—
column2: Jadi... yang kau maksud menyelamatkan garis pertahanan Paradajz itu—

column1: (When they finally arrive at the location Peri mentioned, Sabrina and Qiuhua are clearly taken aback.)
column2: (Saat mereka akhirnya sampai di lokasi yang disebut Peri, Sabrina dan Qiuhua jelas tertegun.)

column1: Takeout is here—!
column2: Pesanan datang—!

column1: (But unlike the stunned Sabrina, Qiuhua doesn't linger. She quickly takes out the packed pizzas and large portions of stir-fry, and begins distributing them to the people present.)
column2: (Tapi tidak seperti Sabrina yang terpaku, Qiuhua tidak berlama-lama. Dia cepat mengeluarkan pizza yang sudah dikemas dan tumisan porsi besar, lalu mulai membagikannya kepada orang-orang di situ.)

column1: W-wait, why did you accept this so quickly!
column2: T-tunggu, kenapa kau menerimanya secepat itu!

column1: (Although she hurriedly keeps up with Qiuhua's food delivery pace, the complaints from Sabrina's mouth never cease.)
column2: (Meski buru-buru mengikuti tempo Qiuhua membagikan makanan, keluhan dari mulut Sabrina tidak berhenti.)

column1: Peri, aren't you going to explain?
column2: Peri, kau tidak mau menjelaskan?

column1: Mhm... that's right.
column2: Mhm... benar.

column1: As you can see, Pradaja has now become a crucial part of the defense line—just as it was originally arranged to be. So, we must now do our part to reorganize the defense line.
column2: Seperti yang kalian lihat, Pradaja sekarang jadi bagian krusial garis pertahanan—persis seperti yang semula diatur. Jadi sekarang kita harus melakukan bagian kita untuk menata ulang garis pertahanannya.

column1: So, what does this have to do with "takeout"...
column2: Lalu apa hubungannya dengan "pesan-antar"...

column1: Here, this is an extra numbing, extra spicy pineapple pizza! Enjoy your meal!
column2: Ini, pizza nanas ekstra kelu ekstra pedas! Selamat menikmati!

column1: (Qiuhua's vibrant voice instantly washes away Sabrina's cautious inquiry.)
column2: (Suara Qiuhua yang penuh semangat seketika menyapu bersih pertanyaan hati-hati Sabrina.)

column1: Wh... what? What on earth are you doing while I'm not looking!
column2: A... apa? Apa yang kau lakukan saat aku tidak melihat!

column1: Oh, thank you! This is my first meal in two days.
column2: Oh, terima kasih! Ini makanan pertamaku dalam dua hari.

column1: (But the Oathguard who took the pizza pulled a cheerful smile—even though this smile looked rather bizarre on a face covered in bandages.)
column2: (Tapi Oathguard yang menerima pizza itu menarik senyum riang—meski senyum itu tampak agak ganjil di wajah yang penuh perban.)

column1: Here, there's also this double-crust pizza with no onions—
column2: Ini, ada juga pizza kulit ganda tanpa bawang—

column1: No... this thing is called a pie, right!
column2: Bukan... benda ini namanya pai, kan!

column1: Thanks, I still prefer Mr. Vasily's taste... this kind of pizza is still tastier.
column2: Terima kasih, aku tetap lebih suka selera Tuan Vasily... pizza seperti ini tetap lebih enak.

column1: ...Never mind, Peri, what exactly is going on here?
column2: ...Sudahlah, Peri, sebenarnya apa yang terjadi di sini?

column1: Didn't we already safely evacuate all the humans in the town?
column2: Bukannya kita sudah mengevakuasi semua manusia di kota ini dengan aman?

column1: (Looking at these injured Oathguards, Sabrina felt a bit confused.)
column2: (Menatap para Oathguard yang terluka itu, Sabrina merasa agak bingung.)

column1: The Underground Brokers who came for business have indeed been evacuated. I contacted some major Underground Brokers and bounty hunters we've worked with before to assist them—maybe even facilitate a few deals. Anyway, they're safe.
column2: Underground Brokers yang datang berdagang memang sudah dievakuasi. Aku menghubungi beberapa Underground Broker besar dan pemburu bayaran yang pernah bekerja sama dengan kita untuk membantu mereka—mungkin sekalian memuluskan beberapa transaksi. Pokoknya mereka aman.

column1: Then who are these people now...
column2: Lalu orang-orang ini siapa...

column1: Mokosh Oathguards. After all, Mokosh has already fallen... Many Oathguards have rushed over, and this will become the new battlefield.
column2: Oathguard Mokosh. Lagi pula Mokosh sudah jatuh... Banyak Oathguard bergegas kemari, dan tempat ini akan jadi medan tempur yang baru.

column1: No matter what, we must pull ourselves together... build a new defense line, and absolutely not allow Mangi Security to advance any further.
column2: Apa pun yang terjadi, kita harus menguatkan diri... membangun garis pertahanan baru, dan sama sekali tidak membiarkan Mangi Security maju lebih jauh.

column1: (Sabrina nodded thoughtfully as she distributed the food to everyone.)
column2: (Sabrina mengangguk sembari terus membagikan makanan kepada semua orang.)

column1: But not everyone is wearing the Oathguard uniform...
column2: Tapi tidak semuanya memakai seragam Oathguard...

column1: Yeah, there are also some Yellow Zone residents who spontaneously wanted to form resistance squads to fight against Mangi Security's attacks.
column2: Iya, ada juga warga Yellow Zone yang dengan sendirinya ingin membentuk regu perlawanan untuk melawan serangan Mangi Security.

column1: ...How could we possibly let them go.
column2: ...Mana mungkin kami melepaskan mereka.

column1: (The person in front of her suddenly speaks, startling Sabrina.)
column2: (Orang di depannya tiba-tiba bicara, mengagetkan Sabrina.)

column1: Our home has already been destroyed by them...
column2: Rumah kami sudah dihancurkan mereka...

column1: How ridiculous, the lords of the White Zone suddenly got the urge to destroy the Yellow Zone? And the reason is just because we managed to feed ourselves with tomatoes?
column2: Konyol sekali, para tuan di White Zone tiba-tiba ingin menghancurkan Yellow Zone? Dan alasannya cuma karena kami berhasil menghidupi diri dengan tomat?

column1: ...I really can't let them off. Even if I die, I'll make those bastards pay the price.
column2: ...Aku benar-benar tidak bisa membiarkan mereka. Meski aku mati, akan kubuat bajingan itu membayar harganya.

column1: (His voice grows more and more agitated, until Qiuhua places a steaming box of food in her arms.)
column2: (Suaranya makin lama makin bergejolak, sampai Qiuhua menaruh kotak makanan yang mengepul di pelukannya.)

column1: Scallion oil pasta, here, eat slowly!
column2: Pasta minyak daun bawang, ini, makan pelan-pelan!

column1: (Qiuhua showed the same smile as before, full of encouragement, optimism, and vitality, making Peri couldn't help but start wanting to make Qiuhua the poster girl for the 'Pradaja' delivery hotline.)
column2: (Qiuhua memperlihatkan senyum yang sama seperti tadi, penuh dorongan, optimisme, dan gairah, sampai Peri tanpa sadar mulai ingin menjadikan Qiuhua wajah iklan hotline pengantaran 'Pradaja'.)

column1: ...Yeah, if we really were to open a delivery shop.
column2: ...Iya, kalau kita benar-benar membuka usaha pesan-antar.

column1: (However, Sabrina's expression didn't look so optimistic.)
column2: (Namun ekspresi Sabrina tidak tampak seoptimistis itu.)

column1: I've been wanting to say this since just now, why are all these weird things my favorite dishes—!
column2: Dari tadi aku ingin bilang, kenapa semua benda aneh ini masakan favoritku—!

column1: You're still throwing a tantrum over that tomato sauce guobaorou from last time, aren't you?
column2: Kau masih merajuk soal guobaorou saus tomat waktu itu, kan?

column1: Huh? What tomato sauce guobaorou? I have no idea what you're talking about.
column2: Hah? Guobaorou saus tomat apa? Aku sama sekali tidak tahu yang kau bicarakan.

column1: Stop playing dumb!
column2: Berhenti pura-pura bodoh!

column1: Innovation is a good thing, but you can't make weird things like that.
column2: Inovasi itu bagus, tapi kau tidak boleh membuat benda aneh seperti itu.

column1: W-weird things?!
column2: B-benda aneh?!

column1: You're the one making weird things—
column2: Kau yang membuat benda aneh—

column1: Here, one portion of century egg and lean meat risotto!
column2: Ini, satu porsi risotto telur pitan dan daging tanpa lemak!

column1: <size=28>You're just completely wasting food!</size>
column2: <size=28>Kau benar-benar cuma menyia-nyiakan makanan!</size>

column1: And don't pretend you can't hear me talking!
column2: Dan jangan pura-pura tidak mendengarku bicara!

column1: Alright, alright.
column2: Sudah, sudah.

column1: (Peri looked at the two who were arguing more and more fiercely, and immediately squeezed between them, creating some distance between them.)
column2: (Peri menatap keduanya yang berdebat makin sengit, lalu langsung menyelip di antara mereka, membuat jarak di antara keduanya.)

column1: Stop arguing, you two. If you want to argue, go back to the kitchen and do it.
column2: Berhenti berdebat, kalian berdua. Kalau mau berdebat, kembali ke dapur dan lakukan di sana.

column1: Anyway, you all understand the current situation now, right?
column2: Pokoknya kalian sudah paham situasinya sekarang, kan?

column1: That goes without saying. The injured should take in more nutrients! I promise to prepare well-balanced meals for them.
column2: Itu tidak perlu dikatakan. Yang terluka harus mendapat lebih banyak nutrisi! Aku berjanji menyiapkan makanan bergizi seimbang untuk mereka.

column1: And the people fighting alongside us must not go hungry either. We have to ensure they have plenty of stamina.
column2: Dan orang-orang yang bertarung bersama kita juga tidak boleh kelaparan. Kita harus memastikan stamina mereka cukup.

column1: Also, we can't let everyone's mood get any worse, right?
column2: Selain itu, kita tidak boleh membiarkan suasana hati semua orang makin buruk, kan?

column1: So no more arguing, okay?
column2: Jadi berhenti berdebat, ya?

column1: (During the conversation, the meals prepared on the vehicle this time had been distributed.)
column2: (Selama percakapan itu, makanan yang disiapkan di kendaraan kali ini sudah habis dibagikan.)

column1: However, everyone's mood doesn't seem too low.
column2: Namun suasana hati semuanya sepertinya tidak terlalu buruk.

column1: Maintaining morale at a time like this is also very important.
column2: Menjaga moral di saat seperti ini juga sangat penting.

column1: How about it, my smile delivery service is somewhat effective, right?
column2: Bagaimana, layanan pengantaran senyumku lumayan manjur, kan?

column1: Hmph... if it's only a smile, with the cooking like that, isn't it still...
column2: Hmph... kalau cuma senyum, dengan masakan seperti itu, tetap saja...

column1: Ah, there's one portion of tomato pasta bread left on the cart!
column2: Ah, masih ada satu porsi roti tomat pasta di gerobak!

column1: (Qiuhua's soft exclamation interrupts Sabrina once again.)
column2: (Seruan lirih Qiuhua kembali memotong Sabrina.)

column1: How many times have I told you, you can't add pasta to tomato bread! You don't even like this kind of food yourself, do you?
column2: Sudah berapa kali kubilang, roti tomat tidak boleh ditambahi pasta! Kau sendiri juga tidak suka makanan seperti itu, kan?

column1: Honestly, would anyone even eat this? If we're going to share it with everyone, I should add some more...
column2: Yang benar saja, ada yang mau makan ini? Kalau mau dibagikan ke semua orang, aku harus menambah sesuatu...

column1: (Sabrina somewhat helplessly opened the only remaining lunchbox, seemingly intending to modify it into an edible meal.)
column2: (Dengan agak tak berdaya Sabrina membuka satu-satunya kotak makan yang tersisa, sepertinya berniat mengubahnya jadi makanan yang layak dimakan.)

column1: Awww...
column2: Aduuuh...

column1: (But the sight that greeted her surprised Sabrina a little—inside the lunchbox, a delicate and beautiful piece of garlic tomato bread was neatly arranged. The aroma of garlic wafted out, garnished with fresh tomatoes and basil.)
column2: (Tapi pemandangan yang menyambutnya sedikit mengejutkan Sabrina—di dalam kotak makan itu tertata rapi sepotong roti tomat bawang putih yang halus dan cantik. Aroma bawang putihnya menguar, dihias tomat segar dan basil.)

column1: You didn't put in any pasta?
column2: Kau tidak menambahkan pasta?

column1: Ah, I probably forgot to put it in.
column2: Ah, mungkin aku lupa memasukkannya.

column1: (Sabrina puts a small piece of tomato bread into her mouth. With a "crunch", the slightly hard, toasted crust of the bread breaks apart in her mouth, followed by the grainy texture of raw garlic and the cool, refreshing, and moist tomato juice spreading across her palate.)
column2: (Sabrina memasukkan sepotong kecil roti tomat ke mulutnya. Dengan bunyi "kres", kulit roti panggang yang agak keras itu pecah di mulutnya, disusul tekstur berbulir bawang putih mentah dan sari tomat yang sejuk, segar, dan basah menyebar di langit-langit mulutnya.)

column1: (Sweet, sour, and salty flavors swirl in her mouth simultaneously. Even Sabrina, who is accustomed to fine food, feels a hint of the happiness brought by food at this moment.)
column2: (Rasa manis, asam, dan asin berputar serentak di mulutnya. Bahkan Sabrina yang terbiasa dengan makanan halus pun saat itu merasakan sedikit kebahagiaan yang dibawa makanan.)

column1: How is it, are you captivated?
column2: Bagaimana, terpikat?

column1: This kind of thing... I'm sick of eating it!
column2: Makanan seperti ini... aku sudah bosan memakannya!

column1: You should just eat it yourself.
column2: Kau makan saja sendiri.

column1: (Sabrina also fed a piece of bread into Qiuhua's mouth.)
column2: (Sabrina juga menyuapkan sepotong roti ke mulut Qiuhua.)

column1: Hmm... it really is just average.
column2: Hmm... memang biasa saja.

column1: It seems I'm still not used to eating this kind of food...
column2: Sepertinya aku memang belum terbiasa makan makanan seperti ini...

column1: 你说什么？！
column2: Apa katamu?!

column1: Speaking of which, Peri, who notified you to deliver the food?
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, Peri, siapa yang memberitahumu untuk mengantar makanannya?

column1: Ah... about that...
column2: Ah... soal itu...

column1: (Peri, having just finished cleaning up the mess, jumps back into the vehicle and waves for her two companions, who are sharing a meal, to get in.)
column2: (Peri yang baru selesai membereskan kekacauannya melompat kembali ke kendaraan dan melambai menyuruh dua rekannya yang sedang berbagi makanan naik.)

column1: It's Florence. She said she has already treated the wounded in this area and wants to order another... uh... 'comforting yet stimulating' takeout for them...
column2: Florence. Katanya dia sudah mengobati korban luka di area ini dan ingin memesan lagi... eh... pesan-antar yang 'menenangkan sekaligus merangsang' untuk mereka...

column1: No wonder those wounded were all properly treated just now... So she was the one who did it.
column2: Pantas tadi semua korban luka itu sudah ditangani dengan benar... Ternyata dia yang melakukannya.

column1: Does that include the person covered in bandages?
column2: Termasuk orang yang penuh perban itu?

column1: His injuries shouldn't be severe... It's probably Miss Florence's special treatment method.
column2: Lukanya seharusnya tidak parah... Itu mungkin metode pengobatan khusus Miss Florence.

column1: However, I still don't quite understand.
column2: Namun aku masih belum begitu paham.

column1: Didn't Peri tell us to prepare the meals a long time ago? Did you know we were coming to deliver food?
column2: Bukannya Peri menyuruh kita menyiapkan makanannya sejak lama? Kau sudah tahu kita akan mengantar makanan?

column1: (Seeing Sabrina and Qiuhua both seated in the back, Peri started the car.)
column2: (Melihat Sabrina dan Qiuhua sudah duduk di belakang, Peri menyalakan mobilnya.)

column1: I guess so...
column2: Kurang lebih begitu...

column1: When did you learn prophecy from Nemesis?
column2: Sejak kapan kau belajar meramal dari Nemesis?

column1: Rather than a prophecy, this should be called intelligence, right?
column2: Daripada ramalan, ini seharusnya disebut intel, kan?

column1: Haven't you stopped being an information broker for a long time?
column2: Bukannya kau sudah lama berhenti jadi makelar informasi?

column1: But this time is different, I have to go all out.
column2: Tapi kali ini berbeda, aku harus mengerahkan segalanya.

column1: First, I contacted the Underground Brokers as logistics to stably provide us with supplies and resources.
column2: Pertama, aku menghubungi Underground Brokers sebagai logistik supaya pasokan dan sumber daya kita mengalir stabil.

column1: Then, we set up the Pradaja hotline and had the other Doll squads leave our communication signal bands for human supporters in need, so they could call us for help at any time.
column2: Lalu kami membuka hotline Pradaja dan menyuruh regu Doll lain meninggalkan pita sinyal komunikasi kami untuk pendukung manusia yang membutuhkan, supaya mereka bisa meminta bantuan kapan saja.

column1: Whether it's food and water, necessary firearms and ammunition, or even enemy intel, I can provide it all to everyone.
column2: Baik makanan dan air, senjata serta amunisi yang diperlukan, bahkan intel musuh, semuanya bisa kusediakan untuk semua orang.

column1: ...What an incredible Underground Broker.
column2: ...Underground Broker yang luar biasa.

column1: (—Beep beep beep beep.)
column2: (—Tit tit tit tit.)

column1: (As she spoke, Peri's communication device rang again.)
column2: (Sembari bicara, perangkat komunikasi Peri kembali berbunyi.)

column1: What is it this time?
column2: Apa lagi kali ini?

column1: I can still make another five hundred bento boxes here!
column2: Aku masih bisa membuat lima ratus kotak bento lagi di sini!

column1: If nothing unexpected happens, it should be a new order.
column2: Kalau tidak ada kejadian tak terduga, ini seharusnya pesanan baru.

column1: (Peri pressed the answer button and greeted before the other side of the communication could make a sound.)
column2: (Peri menekan tombol jawab dan menyapa sebelum pihak seberang sempat bersuara.)

column1: (Although she successfully rebooted, in order to participate in the support as soon as possible, she didn't deeply inspect her frame and rushed non-stop to her companions' side. This caused her to occasionally experience situations where her strength fell short of her desires like this.)
column2: (Meski berhasil reboot, demi ikut membantu secepat mungkin dia tidak memeriksa frame-nya secara mendalam dan bergegas tanpa henti ke sisi rekan-rekannya. Itu membuatnya sesekali mengalami keadaan seperti ini, saat tenaganya tidak sepadan dengan keinginannya.)
